description: Write an email draft for a human to review. NOTHING IS SENT: the draft waits in `pending_review` until a person approves it from the dashboard, and the approval is what delivers it. Use this when the account wants a human to see a message before it leaves — a credential that holds `drafts:write` and not `messages:send` can only ever reach this tool. Pass `text` or `html` for a hand-written draft, or `useAiContext: true` with a `replyToMessageId` to have the reply written from the domain's AI context and address persona (the plan must include AI context). `from` must be on a domain this account owns and inside the credential's bound domain set. Read the outcome with `list_drafts` / `get_draft`.

from.description: The sending address — on a domain this account owns, and inside the credential's bound set.

replyToMessageId.description: Reply in thread: the parent message's SMTP Message-ID from a `list_events` row. Required when `useAiContext` is true.

text.description: The plain-text body. Required unless `html` or `useAiContext` is given.

to.description: One recipient address, or an array of up to 50.

useAiContext.description: Draft the reply from the domain's AI context and address persona. Requires `replyToMessageId`.

name: create_draft
